lucee.notes:
Evicts cached query results from the second-level query cache. If `cacheName` is provided, only that named cache region is evicted. Otherwise the default query cache is evicted.

Only relevant when `secondaryCacheEnabled` is `true` and queries are run with `cacheable: true`.

See [[orm-caching]] for query cache details.

name: ORMEvictQueries
description: Evicts all queries from the named query cache. If cacheName is not specified, evicts the default query cache.

params.name: cacheName
params.description: Name of the cache region that you want to evict

params.name: datasource
params.description: datasource used for the session, if nor defined the datasource defined in application.cfc/cfapplication is used.
